office: the Department of Consular Affairs (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

routes.label: express, collected the day of application

note: The fees are the Department of Consular Affairs' own (its fee page, updated 11 March 2024, read rendered on 2026-11-03): 1,000 baht for five years and 1,500 for ten, normal; 3,000 and 3,500 for express, collected the same day if applied for before 11:00. They are the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' notice of 23 February 2021 (Royal Gazette, in force 11 March 2021) as Krungthep Turakij reproduced it; the Royal Gazette's site refused this client (403). That the ten-year passport is for those 20 and over is the same paper's report of the Department opening it, not on the fee page. A normal passport is posted in 2 to 3 working days in Bangkok and 3 to 5 elsewhere, after a production time the page doesn't give, so no time is written for it. The fees at missions abroad are leads.
